title: Relaxing Cross-Modal Correspondence for Multimodal Remote Sensing Pretraining
abstract: arXiv:2611.13807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal remote sensing pretraining commonly relies on exact instance-level correspondence across modalities, implicitly treating strictly paired observations as a prerequisite for learning transferable representations. In this work, we revisit this assumption by relaxing cross-modal correspondence from the instance level to the semantic level. We introduce Semantic Pairing (SemPair), a pairing-relaxed pretraining strategy that replaces exact instance pairs with class-consistent cross-instance pairs. To characterize the effect of correspondence relaxation, we formulate a latent-factor model that separates cross-modal dependence into shared semantic structure and instance-specific correlation, showing that SemPair preserves the former while marginalizing instance-specific cross-modal correlations in expectation. translated_title: 放宽跨模态对应关系的多模态遥感预训练
translated_abstract: 多模态遥感预训练通常依赖于跨模态之间精确的实例级对应关系，隐含地将严格配对的观测数据视为学习可迁移表示的先决条件。在这项工作中，我们通过将跨模态对应关系从实例级放宽到语义级来重新审视这一假设。我们提出了语义配对（SemPair），这是一种配对放宽的预训练策略，用类别一致的跨实例配对来替代精确的实例配对。为了刻画对应关系放宽的影响，我们构建了一个潜在因子模型，将跨模态依赖分解为共享语义结构和实例特定相关性，并表明 SemPair 在期望意义上保留前者，同时边缘化实例特定的跨模态相关性。我们进一步提出了混合配对（MixPair），作为语义配对和精确配对之间的受控插值方法，用以研究对应关系放宽……
tldr: 该论文提出 SemPair 预训练策略，将多模态遥感预训练中的跨模态对应要求从实例级放宽到语义级，用类别一致的跨实例配对替代严格配对，并通过潜在因子模型理论分析和 MixPair 插值方法系统研究对应关系放宽的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SemPair, a pretraining strategy for multimodal remote sensing that relaxes cross-modal correspondence from the instance level to the semantic level by using class-consistent cross-instance pairs instead of strictly paired data, supported by a latent-factor model analysis and the MixPair interpolation method.
